name: pcs-platform
description: Aplicatie full-stack pentru Partidul Politic PCS

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client && npm run lint:repo
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run db:check-schema && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace server
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && npm run test:smoke:compiled
scripts.test:e2e:browser:fullstack: NODE_ENV=test AUTH_REFRESH_ENABLED=1 AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=1000 VOLUNTEER_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=1000 CAPTCHA_MODE=disabled EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=false CORS_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4010 CORS_CREDENTIALS=true PORT=4010 npm run build && NODE_ENV=test AUTH_REFRESH_ENABLED=1 AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=1000 VOLUNTEER_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=1000 CAPTCHA_MODE=disabled EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=false CORS_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4010 CORS_CREDENTIALS=true PORT=4010 node server/dist/scripts/migrateDb.js && playwright test --config=playwright.fullstack.config.ts
